text:
Alex K: alertmanager -> us-west-2 GPU pool depleted, pods pending: https://dash.redwood.ai/cluster/us-west-2
Ops Bot: ALERT nodepool/us-west-2-gpu available_gpus=0 for 3m :rotating_light:
Priya R: checking... kubectl shows many Pending with InsufficientGPUs/PodFitsHostPorts
Priya R: ```
NAME                       READY STATUS   RESTARTS AGE   NODE
serve-model-xy-123         0/1   Pending 0        10s  <none>
batch-infer-2026-04-01     0/1   Pending 0        2m   <none>  nodeSelector: gpu
```
Jamie L: cluster-autoscaler logs: "scale-up disabled: would exceed nodepool max" - autoscaler respects nodepool.max
Dave T: we manually capped nodepool after last month's cost run-up to 40 nodes, autoscaler can't exceed that
Sasha M: cloud provider shows spike in spot terminations ~5 nodes in last 8m
Priya R: also see a cron job launching 100 parallel pods with priorityClass=low; it wasn't configured with concurrencyPolicy
Alex K: immediate steps: 1) suspend cronjob, 2) start on-demand emergency nodepool, 3) cordon/taint low-priority nodes, 4) route heavy realtime to reduced-size model variant
Jamie L: creating on-demand pool us-west-2-gpu-ondemand-temp +30 nodes via infra console, ETA ~6m
Sasha M: cordoned low-priority nodepool and applied taint dedicated=low:NoSchedule to keep critical pods safe :white_check_mark:
Priya R: suspended cronjob: kubectl patch cronjob -n infra batch-heavy --patch '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'
Jamie L: on-demand nodegroup created, nodes registering... kubelet reports Ready for 18/30
Ops Bot: Event: nodegroup/us-west-2-gpu-ondemand-temp scaled 0->30
Dave T: cluster-autoscaler config note: maxNodes for main gpu pool is 40; propose PR to raise to 80 and add auto-detection of nodepool caps
Priya R: also adding --balance-similar-node-groups=false to avoid identical-group burst and --expander=least-waste
Alex K: short-term cost override: Finance approval required to keep on-demand nodes beyond 90 minutes - estimated burn $4.5k per 24h
Finance Bot: Noted. Please document expected window and tag cost center: eng-infra
Sasha M: killed runaway pods, pending queue draining. Monitoring spot termination rate for next 30m.
Jamie L: scaledown tweak: set --scale-down-delay-after-add=20m to reduce oscillation
Dave T: post-incident TODOs: (a) enforce concurrencyPolicy: Forbid on heavy cronjobs, (b) set sensible priorityClass for critical workloads, (c) alert when nodepool hits maxNodes, (d) chaos test for spot churn
Alex K: filing INC-2026-044 with timeline and estimated cost. Leaving cronjob suspended until patch rolled out
Priya R: logs and commands saved to /ops/incidents/INC-2026-044
Ops Bot: Incident state -> mitigation_in_progress
Sasha M: pending pods cleared, services healthy. Keeping on-demand pool up for 60m then re-evaluate with Finance
Alex K: thanks all. If any reappearance, page SRE. Closing active mitigation in 30m if stable
Ops Bot: Incident resolved - mitigation_completed
